entries.name: Telegram
entries.description: Send messages to Telegram chats and channels via the Telegram Bot API, billed per call via x402 on Base and Solana (served through the Orbis gateway).

usage.callShape: POST https://orbisapi.com/proxy/telegram-send-api-0610c1 with JSON body {chat_id, text} (Telegram Bot API sendMessage shape; chat_id required)
usage.outputShape: Unknown (untested). Expected Telegram Bot API sendMessage result at body.result (message_id, chat, date, text) when ok:true.
quirks: Outward/irreversible: sends a real Telegram message.
inputSchema is empty ({}); body shape must be inferred from the Telegram Bot API (sendMessage) -> requires chat_id + text.

Requires a destination Telegram chat_id (numeric chat ID or @channel/@username) that must already be reachable by the gateway's bot. The proxy does NOT supply a default destination (managedResource null).
orbisapi.com/proxy slug = known charge-then-404 pattern: a 402 on unpaid preflight does NOT mean it works; pay at most once and treat any post-pay 404/4xx/HTML/refund as broken.
Not paid during QA: no valid Telegram chat_id available for the test recipient (email/phone/address are not Telegram identifiers).
MARKED DEAD 2026-06-11 (ash): push/notification provider not viable (Orbis charge-then-404 / requires bring-your-own key). Not exposed.
usage.guide: This is an Orbis-gateway proxy for the Telegram Bot API sendMessage, billed $0.005 via x402 on Base (or Solana). To call it, POST JSON {chat_id, text} to https://orbisapi.com/proxy/telegram-send-api-0610c1 and pay the x402 quote once. chat_id must be a real Telegram chat ID or @channel that the gateway's bot can post to; there is no default destination, so you cannot send without it. On success expect a Telegram Bot API response (ok:true, result.message_id). It was NOT tested in QA because no Telegram chat_id was available for the recipient, and as an orbisapi.com/proxy slug it carries the known charge-then-404 risk — verify the slug is live before relying on it.

entries.name: Slack
entries.description: Post messages to Slack channels and users via the Slack Web API (chat.postMessage and other methods), proxied over an x402 pay-per-call gateway (HTTPay) at $0.001 per call.

usage.callShape: POST https://httpay.xyz/api/gateway/slack/api/chat.postMessage with JSON body {channel, text} AND header X-Upstream-Token: <your Slack bot token>
usage.outputShape: Slack Web API response: body.ok (bool), body.ts, body.channel, body.message; on failure body.error
quirks: NOT keyless: the gateway 402s on the unpaid preflight but then requires YOUR OWN Slack bot token passed via the X-Upstream-Token header (authType=bearer). Without it the proxy returns {"error":"Service 'slack' requires authentication"} even after you pay.
Free demo mode exists: append ?demo=true (10 calls/IP/hour, no payment) to test before paying. Use it to confirm auth/destination before spending.
chat.postMessage also needs a real Slack channel ID (e.g. C0123456789) or @user; there is no default channel.
Outward/irreversible: posts a real Slack message.
MPP alt payment available (Tempo pathUSD) in addition to x402 on Base; payTo 0x5f5d6FcB315871c26F720dc6fEf17052dD984359.
MARKED DEAD 2026-06-11 (ash): push/notification provider not viable (Orbis charge-then-404 / requires bring-your-own key). Not exposed.
needs: Slack bot/upstream token for X-Upstream-Token header
usage.guide: This HTTPay gateway proxies the Slack Web API but is NOT keyless: you must supply your own Slack bot token in the X-Upstream-Token header and target a real channel ID, plus pay $0.001 via x402. POST {"channel":"C...","text":"..."} with X-Upstream-Token set; read body.ok and body.ts on success or body.error on failure. Test safely first with ?demo=true (free, 10/IP/hr). MasterKey has no Slack token/channel, so classify needs-input.
